schema.description:
The association of an entity; e.g., Facility or an Emission Activity, to a Compliance Requirement defined
by a Standard.
schema.title: Compliance Requirement

standard_id.description: Foreign Key of the standard that defines the Compliance Requirement.

compliance_target_id.description:
The Foreign Key identifying the entity that this compliance requirement applies to. 

Note, for RDBMS the Facility Id and Emission Activity Id foreign keys are provided to define a specific constraint for this compliance requirement. These constraints can be substituted by the Compliance Target Type and Compliance Target Id pair (if supported by your RDBMS).

emission_activity_id.description: Foreign Key of the activity to which the parameter is assigned.

compliance_target_type.description:
The Compliance Target Type specifies the target entity associated with a compliance obligation, such as an emissions disclosure or carbon tax requirement. It is a string field that classifies the compliance target as either a Facility or an Emission Activity.

The field serves as an abstract linking mechanism to pair a Compliance Requirement with the appropriate operational entity:

* When the target type is Facility, compliance applies to a particular physical site, plant, or installation

* When the target type is Emission Activity, it applies to a specific process or activity contributing to emissions

facility_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Facility to which this attribute is directly linked (if available).

id.description: The Primary Key of the Compliance Requirement.
Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
